name: Ermahgerd
look: An old snapshot of a girl with curly pigtails and a retainer, in a white shirt and patterned vest, grinning wide-mouthed as she fans out three Goosebumps books at the camera. A blue backpack hangs from her arm in front of an orange curtain.
use: Gushing, over-the-top excitement typed in a garbled accent, as if spoken through a retainer. Vowels turn into "er", so "oh my god, books" becomes "ermahgerd, berks", and the caption names the thing she is thrilled about.
slots: the beloved thing in the same garbled spelling (bottom)
